<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that converts the product alkene back to the ketone and trimethylsilyl precursor (Peterson reaction). We'll search the template catalog for a template that breaks a C=C bond and forms a C=O and C-Si bond (i.e., functional_groups_broken=["alkene"], functional_groups_formed=["ketone","trimethylsilyl"]). We'll then retrieve its template_id.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccc(cc1)C= C(Cc2ccc(OC)cc2)",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkene"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone", "trimethylsilyl"]
}</action_input>
